stages.title: Stage 2 - run({page,name}) verifies Continue alpha -> done-alpha

module.description: Verify harness: run({page,name}) with name=alpha from Stage 1. Preconditions: fresh page, input name is 'alpha'. Steps: page.setContent local button Continue alpha; click button; role=status shows done-alpha; Playwright expect verifies actual page result; returns {name,status}. No imports of other Modules, no navigation, fetch, or file reads. Postconditions: returned {name,status} matches page status done-alpha.
